# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
## [6.0.0] - 2026-10-10

### Changed
- Remove plugins that do not support Fastify v5 (#7075)
- Use a FIFO cache for parsed content-types (#7071)
- List fastify-mariadb as a community plugin (#7062)
- Avoid resetting the level of request child loggers (#7056)
- Add @validex/fastify to community plugins (#6660)
- Decode string bodies once instead of per chunk (#7049)
- Restrict route lookup methods (#6963)
- Read the merged headers once in the trust proxy getters (#7039)
- Clarify headers validation is additive, not a sanitized view (#7029)

### Fixed
- Copy a set-cookie array passed to reply.header instead of storing it (#7068)
- Resolve reply.mediaType from raw response headers (#7054)
- Remove error when HTTP QUERY request has empty body (#6929)
- Omit absent compileSerializationSchema metadata instead of passing null (#7001)
- Restore this context in route shorthand hooks (#6975)
- Custom logger instance not assignable to FastifyInstance (#6901)
